The appellant has been convicted under Sections 366A and 376 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act, 2012 vide judgment dated 17.05.2024 passed by the learned Exclusive Court (POCSO), Saharsa in Special (POCSO) Case No. 04 of 2015 / 12 of 2015, arising out of Bihra P.S. Case No. 221 of 2014.
By order dated 27.05.2024, he has been sentenced to undergo S.I. for ten years and to pay a fine of Rs. 10,000/- under Section 366A of Patna High Court CR.

APP (DB)
No.913 of 2024(4) dt.08-10-2024 the IPC; R.I. for twenty years and to pay a fine of Rs. 25,000/-
under Section 376 of the IPC; and R.I. for twenty years and to pay a fine of Rs. 25,000/- under Section 4 of the POCSO Act, 2012.
In default of payment of fine, to further suffer S.I. for three months.
